difficulty_reason: The lemma exhibits the tensor-Hom adjunction for complexes as a canonical isomorphism between the internal Hom into an internal Hom and the internal Hom out of the total tensor product, and the proof is a 51-line argument that builds both directions explicitly. It expands an element of the left hand side into components indexed by a triple of degrees, uses the tensor-Hom identification in each bidegree to view the components as maps out of a tensor product, displays the differential on both sides with their signs under the sign rule for the associated simple complex, and then checks that the two resulting descriptions of the differential agree. The identification in each bidegree and the sign comparison are the substance, and both are displayed in the source.
